h: May Edochie opens new store in Lagos and speaks about setbacks before the launch
p: Yul Edochie's estranged wife, May, has reportedly opened a new store in Lagos and shared some of the difficulties she faced before the launch. Her fans have flooded social media with congratulations.
more: The launch comes the same day Judy Austin reacted to Yul Edochie's throwback clips featuring May.
May has been building her business and brand since the family saga became public.
